liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Box Of Rain** (2 reviews): The show opens with Box of Rain running into Visions of Johanna, which the reviewer found striking; Brent plays a small keyboard flourish just before the Box of Rain opener [8][10]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Jerry makes bird-chirp sounds with his guitar and samples them back, an effect the reviewer heard at other shows too; Bird Song features tweety-bird guitar effects [9][16]
- **Big River** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Big River as very nice, along with Deal and China Cat into Rider; Big River is unusually hot [12][16]
- **Spoonful** (2 other sources): A Truckin' tease comes before and after Spoonful [2][6]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Brent's break in Rooster is called the funniest he ever played, and the reviewer says it will have you laughing [10]
- **Deal** (1 review): Brent, though very drunk, handles the B3 organ capably on Deal [10]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): The band doesn't continue into Playin' after Terrapin, a tease the reviewer found irritating [12]
- **Visions Of Johanna** (1 review): Box of Rain leads into a sweet, up-tempo Visions, with strong chunky rhythm and lead guitar late in the song [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-04-22 01 Crowd Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 02 Box Of Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 03 Visions Of Johanna**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 04 Mama Tried**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 05 Big River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 06 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 07 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-22 08 Deal**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-22.140245.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1986-04-22.sbd-pcm.miller.34768.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Clear soundboard with the vocals mixed somewhat forward; Static is present through most of the second set [2][15]
- **gd86-04-22.aud.eD.13583.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [4]
- **gd1986-04-22.sbd.miller.34767.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min; rated 2.8/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: There are level problems in Bird Song [6]

## Around the show

- Right at the start, someone, possibly Brent, plays a bit of Dixie [11]
- Reviewer says Brent was clearly intoxicated, making the show spotty [12]
- Jerry plays his Tiger guitar throughout both sets [17]
- The first set's song order differs from the usual arrangement [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-22.140245.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 (110 degree ORTF)> Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk >… [1]
- **gd1986-04-22.sbd-pcm.miller.34768.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> PCM -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> PCM -> Dat [2]
- **gd86-04-22.aud.eD.13583.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>PCM>DAT>CDR [4]. Also: Reviewer has a soundboard of the first set, plus a first-set board for 4/18/86 [13]
- **gd1986-04-22.sbd.miller.34767.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) D [6]. Also: Soundboard from cassettes via Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, then PCM and DAT; Drums patched using a source from David Gans [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [20]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [21]
